name: heartbeat
job: Read the file at config/HEARTBEAT.md and complete the tasks described there.

name: daily-check
job: Check for dependency updates in package.json and report any outdated packages.

name: daily-check-openai
job: Check for dependency updates in package.json and report any outdated packages.

name: picklist-auto-check
command: doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash -c 'cd skills/active/picklist-ops && ./run.sh --auto'
_comment: Auto-batch: triggers a picklist when >=25 orders are in ready status, or after the 1-hour time-limit. Requires PICKLIST_READY_STATUS_ID in Doppler.

name: picklist-morning-batch
command: doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash -c 'cd skills/active/picklist-ops && ./run.sh --morning'
_comment: Morning batch: prints ALL orders in ready status at 07:30 with no 25-order cap. Catches everything that arrived overnight.
